name: GlideTableHierarchy
title: GlideTableHierarchy - Scoped
summary: The GlideTableHierarchy API provides methods for handling information about table relationships.

members.name: GlideTableHierarchy
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
tableName String The name of the table. 
var table = new GlideTableHierarchy("incident"); 
gs.info(table.getTables());
Output:
incident,task

members.name: getAllExtensions
members.summary: Returns an array of strings containing all tables that extend the current table and includes the current table.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Array An array of strings containing the tables in the hierarchy that includes the current table. 
var table = new GlideTableHierarchy("task"); 
gs.info(table.getAllExtensions());

Output: Line breaks added for clarity.

task,sc_task,problem_task,change_phase,sc_req_item,kb_submission,
release_phase,problem,ticket,sm_task,hr_task,change_task,change_request,
change_request_imac,incident,release_task,vtb_task,sm_order,hr_case,
sysapproval_group,sc_request

members.name: getBase
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
String The parent class. 
var table = new GlideTableHierarchy("cmdb_ci_server"); 
gs.info(table.getBase());
Output:
cmdb_ci_computer

members.name: getHierarchy
members.summary: Returns an array of strings containing all classes in the hierarchy of the current table.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
none
Returns
Type Description
Array An array of strings of the classes in the hierarchy. 
var table = new GlideTableHierarchy("incident"); 
gs.info(table.getHierarchy());
Output:
incident,task

members.name: getName
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
String The table's name. 
var table = new GlideTableHierarchy("incident");

members.name: getRoot
members.summary: Returns the top level class in the hierarchy.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description

members.name: isBaseClass
members.summary: Returns true if this is a base class.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Boolean True if the current table has no parent and has extensions. 
var table = new GlideTableHierarchy("incident"); 
gs.info(table.isBaseClass());
Output:
false

members.name: isSoloClass
members.summary: Returns true if this table is not in a hierarchy.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Boolean True if the current table has no parent and no extensions. 
var table = new GlideTableHierarchy("sys_user"); 
gs.info(table.isSoloClass());
Output:
true
